title: $200K-funded fifth-dimension gravity theory report handed in

tellings.quote: I handed them a report and they said, "Thank you, Dr. Brandenburg. Here's your check. Don't let the door hit you when you go out of the building."

plain: John Brandenburg, a physicist, says an unnamed US government funder paid him about $200,000 to work on a theory of gravity involving a fifth dimension. He tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that when he handed in his report they thanked him, gave him his check and told him not to let the door hit him on the way out. He tells it to show how such ideas get paid for and then quietly dropped.
